highlights.title: Operação Vivaldi: Como a Ucrânia frustrou os planos da Rússia para cercar o Donbass
highlights.summary: Em vitória estratégica, contraofensiva no norte da região de Donetsk foi bem-sucedida em frustrar tentativa russa de flanquear o chamado "cinturão de fortalezas" ucraniano.

highlights.title: Judges in Israel Suggest Dropping Key Corruption Case Against Netanyahu
highlights.summary: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is accused of bribery, fraud and breach of trust in a long-running trial that has divided the country. He denies all wrongdoing.

highlights.title: Baby Aliyah steals the show during Australian Senate debate
highlights.summary: Australian Senator Fatima Payman addressed the Senate with her six-month-old daughter, Aliyah, in her arms

highlights.title: Island Paradise of Mauritius Has Sun, Beaches and Too Many Dogs
highlights.summary: Mauritius, a popular tourist destination off southern Africa, has become overrun with strays. With more and more residents chased and attacked, many are fed up.
